data.name: KN Tower - Build your skyscraper empire
data.detailed_description:
Start with a small building and develop it floor by floor into a massive skyscraper.

Plan the layout, decide on the use of each floor and combine apartments, offices, shops, leisure facilities and hotels into a functioning building complex.

You decide how your tower grows and what story it tells.


Thousands of residents, office workers, visitors and hotel guests need to reach their destinations reliably every day.

Plan elevators, stairs, entrances and lobbies so that people can move through your tower quickly and without long waiting times.

Prevent overcrowded areas, identify bottlenecks and adapt the traffic routes to the growth of your building.


Every group of people in your tower has their own requirements.

Residents want to live comfortably, office workers need a functioning work environment, visitors look for shopping and entertainment, while hotel guests place particular value on service and comfort.

Set up suitable facilities and services:

  • Snack bars and restaurants
  • Shops and service providers
  • Cinemas and leisure facilities
  • Ballrooms and event spaces
  • Further amenities for daily needs

Make sure that the right services are available in the right place and that the needs of all groups of people are met.

Only when residents, office workers, visitors and hotel guests feel comfortable can your tower be successful in the long term.

🏨 BUILD AND ORGANIZE YOUR OWN HOTEL


Integrate a hotel into your skyscraper and ensure smooth operations.

Plan hotel rooms, receptions, restaurants and other service areas. Make sure your guests can check in quickly, reach their rooms and are well looked after during their stay.

A well-organized hotel brings new visitors and additional revenue to your tower.

🗑️ ENSURE CLEANLINESS IN THE TOWER


Where many people live and work, a large amount of waste is produced every day.

Plan an efficient waste management system, organize disposal and prevent garbage from piling up in your building.

Place waste collection points sensibly, optimize transport routes and ensure that apartments, offices, restaurants and public areas remain clean.

A clean tower increases the satisfaction of its residents, employees, guests and visitors.

🚨 ENSURE SECURITY IN THE TOWER


The larger your building becomes, the more important security and organization become.

Set up security centers, employ suitable personnel and respond to disruptions and unexpected events.

Monitor critical areas and ensure that residents, guests, visitors and employees are protected at all times.

📊 KEEP AN EYE ON YOUR BALANCE SHEETS


Every new floor and every facility incurs costs.

Monitor your income and expenses, plan investments and decide when the right time for the next expansion has come.

  • Manage rental income and operating costs
  • Invest in new floors and facilities
  • Optimize unprofitable areas
  • Develop your tower into a successful business

Build smart, fulfill people's needs and create a skyscraper that never stands still.

YOUR TOWER. YOUR DECISIONS. YOUR STORY.

data.short_description: Build, expand and manage your own skyscraper in this deep building and management simulation. Design every floor, optimize elevators, manage tenants, businesses and finances. Create a vibrant vertical metropolis.

English*, French*, Italian*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Arabic*, Traditional Chinese*, Simplified Chinese*, Japanese*, Korean*, Polish*, Portuguese - Portugal*, Russian*, Thai*, Turkish*
*languages with full audio support
